description: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (South Africa)
full_name: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013

child.description: Parental or guardian consent required for persons under 18

adult.description: Explicit consent from data subject required

right_to_access.description: Data subject may request confirmation and access to their personal information

right_to_correction.description: Data subject may request correction or deletion of inaccurate, irrelevant, or outdated information

right_to_deletion.description: Data subject may request deletion where processing is unlawful or data is no longer needed

right_to_objection.description: Data subject may object to processing of personal information at any time

right_to_data_portability.description: Data subject may receive personal information in a structured, commonly used format

data_processing_agreement.description: Operator agreement required with all third-party processors (operators)

privacy_impact_assessment.description: Privacy Impact Assessment recommended for high-risk processing activities

parental_consent.description: Parental or guardian consent mandatory for persons under 18

right_to_access.description: Must provide access to personal information within 30 days of request

right_to_deletion.description: Must delete or correct personal information upon legitimate request

data_breach_notification.description: Must notify the Information Regulator within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach

information_officer.description: Responsible Party must designate an Information Officer registered with the Information Regulator

privacy_notice.description: Must notify data subjects of the purpose of collection before or at time of collection

cross_border_transfers.description: Transfers to countries with adequate protection or with data subject consent and contractual safeguards

location_data.description: Location data is sensitive; short retention and explicit consent required

automatic_decision_making.description: Automated decision-making that affects data subjects without human review is restricted

profiling.description: Automated profiling of children and for non-educational purposes prohibited

biometric_data.description: Biometric data is a special category requiring explicit consent and heightened protection

warnings: POPIA applies to all processing of personal information of South African data subjects
Parental or guardian consent is required for all persons under 18
You must register an Information Officer with the Information Regulator
Special-category data (race, health, biometric) requires explicit consent and extra safeguards
Breach must be reported to the Information Regulator within 72 hours
Cross-border transfers require adequate protection or explicit consent
You must notify data subjects of the purpose and processing of their personal information
requirements: Register an Information Officer with the Information Regulator of South Africa
Obtain explicit parental consent before collecting data from persons under 18
Implement a privacy notice (PAIA manual) for all data collection activities
Establish lawful basis for each processing activity from the 8 POPIA conditions
Have a processing agreement (operator contract) with all third-party processors
Implement data minimisation and purpose limitation principles
Maintain a data breach response plan with 72-hour notification capability
Honor data subject rights: access, correction, deletion, objection, portability
Implement security safeguards appropriate to the risk of the processing activity
Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments for high-risk processing activities
